_comment: The one place the site Content-Security-Policy is written down (HFY-TSK-149, review PS-11, BRD 'no third-party calls from family pages'). infrastructure/cloudformation/app-stack.yaml (SiteCspPolicy, SiteCspReportOnlyPolicy) and scripts/cloudfront/join-csp.js (JOIN_CSP) must hold these exact strings; scripts/cloudfront/test/site-csp.test.mjs and scripts/infra/test/test_app_stack.py pin them. The policy covers HTML pages (the default cache behavior); the /uploads/* sandbox CSP and the gated data behaviors are separate and unchanged. script-src and style-src allow 'unsafe-inline' because every page carries the inline shell-hint head script and the feature-flag block; img-src and connect-src are what enforce 'no third party'. The v3 map adds worker-src 'self' later (viz-v3-csp-worker).
base: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
join: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; frame-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; frame-ancestors 'none'
